title: Rational indexed monomial
statement: Let $\iota$ be an index set, let $S$ be a finite subset of $\iota$, and let $x$ assign a sign in $\{ -1,1\}$ to each index. The rational indexed monomial of $x$ on $S$ is $\prod_{i\in S} x_i$, viewed as a rational number.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the index set
Each coordinate of $x$ is a sign
